items.title: Wall Street Cheers Disney’s Report. Here’s Our New Price Target
items.summary: Disney just posted its fifth straight earnings beat and sent streaming profits soaring, but the stock still sits nearly 10% in the red for the year. Our model puts a specific number on where shares go from here and why Wall Street's celebration may still be underselling the real opportunity.
